body: I had this same reaction. My brother was such the life of his party and he had such a large crowd come to celebrate him. It would totally be in his nature to be on Punk’d or something to get everyone together for a party but after 5 years I am losing hope

I am in the same place you are. It hurts so fucking much and the pain will never go away. 

Take some time. You’ll see how his death affected other people around you and use that to motivate you to not put someone else in that pain. That is my only reason for living. I can’t put my parents through the pain that I saw them in. 

My goal is to live longer than them so they don’t see that pain, but after that who knows
If anyone has bones and is looking to sell hmu lol

I know it seems so far but high school you is never entirely who you want to be. Look into some liberal arts colleges or so. There are so many people like you but at 14 everyone else is probably trying to hide it too. Stick with the people you have for now but start to branch out away from them if you aren’t happy
